label: Generating all primes
subgoals: Enumerate the implicants of the function
Discard every implicant contained in a larger one

label: Essential primes
subgoals: List, for each ON minterm, the primes that cover it
Mark minterms covered by exactly one prime
Count the distinct primes those minterms force

label: What the essentials leave behind
subgoals: Union the minterms of the essential primes
Count the minterms left for the covering step
